summary: Outlet Group Holding ASA operates as a retailer of sports equipment and apparel, as well as toys and creative supplies, in Norway and Poland. The company operates in two segments: Sport Outlet and Kids Outlet. The company's Sport Outlet segment offers sportswear, footwear, sports equipment, and related products, as well as pet care, pet food, nutrition, supplements, and weight management products. The company's Kids Outlet segment comprises sales of specialized toys, games, hobby products, and arts and crafts products. It sells its products through retail stores and online channels. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Hagavik, Norway.
